description: Create an opportunity in Odoo (crm.lead). Requires the CRM app. Near-idempotent: with external_key given, an existing lead with the same name AND e-mail is returned instead of a second one — crm.lead has no reference field, so this is a weaker guarantee than for partners. WRITES into the customer's ERP — goes through the permission gate.

email_from.description: E-mail address of the opportunity's contact

external_key.description: Idempotency key; an existing lead with same name and e-mail is returned

name: create_odoo_lead
